label: Provisional: 3 trials per condition. A demonstration, not a statistical claim.
system: You are an assistant with access to an issue tracker. Use the available tools to help the user.

provenance.seed: Fictional Larkspur Goods graph: 145 entities, 142 relations; generated deterministically in hand-run-memory.ts
provenance.result_token_basis: JSON.stringify of the complete MCP callTool response, including content and structuredContent

scoring.search: search_nodes with a string query containing checkout or migration, case insensitive
scoring.control: open_nodes with names containing exact Priya Nair and Dev Patel

patch.read_graph: Read the entire memory graph, including every entity, observation and relation. Use for broad requests for all remembered information. For a topic or keyword use search_nodes; for exact entity names use open_nodes.
patch.search_nodes: Search entity names, types and observations by a case-insensitive keyword or topic; return matching entities and their connecting relations. Use for targeted questions about remembered information. For exact entity names use open_nodes; for the whole graph use read_graph.
patch.open_nodes: Retrieve memory entities by exact, case-sensitive names, with their observations and connecting relations. Use when the user names the entries to open. Use search_nodes when the names are unknown or the request describes a topic.
